outputs.DETERMINISM_NOTES: solve.sh performs deterministic sorted installation/gofmt/build; Ansible execution uses structured exec.CommandContext argv; generated playbooks are temporary and cleaned on all terminal paths; normalized equivalent representations suppress false churn.
PRESERVED_BEHAVIOR: Terraform-owned state and native drift semantics
outputs.RESTART_IDEMPOTENCY_BEHAVIOR: The completion derives identity from external keys and reconstructs observed state natively, so a fresh Terraform/provider process can converge on the same object without transient provider memory or replaying Ansible during Read.
RESTORED_INVARIANTS: stable documented external-object IDs across mutable updates
native side-effect-free Read/refresh with absence and drift reconciliation
state publication only after successful mutation; failures preserve prior state and retryability
scoped deletion for symlink, named text entries, accounts and cron siblings
structured ansible-playbook argv with literal data, timeout/cancel propagation and temp-playbook cleanup
Terraform Core remains sole durable state authority
RISKS_FOR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER: Fresh empirical Oracle/NOP execution is not asserted by this stage and must be re-earned at DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION.
Verifier should independently exercise failed update/delete retryability, process timeout/cancellation, literal argv handling, sibling preservation, and restart/idempotency behavior.
